name: dev-memory-experience-capture
title: Add lightweight dev-memory experience capture outside Koala stories
description: Create a low-friction experience memory layer so normal Claude/Codex/Gemini programming sessions can capture workflow designs, failure modes, success patterns, and open issue lessons even when users are not running a Koala story. When a Koala story is active, capture story-scoped experience candidates and allow export to project/global reusable memory.
source: user-approved 5 milestone plan for preserving agent programming experience outside Koala
